analysis:
## Technical analysis (Friday July 3, 2026 — US holiday, no official session)

**Holiday gap status:** No US trading session today. The framework's stop clock is frozen. The July 2 confirmed close of $193.70 remains Stop Day 1; July 6 will be the first opportunity for Stop Day 2 confirmation or isolation.

**Macro trend improving:** Through the holiday gap, every major macro input has moved favorably for NVDA: SPX futures +0.7% above the 7,460 gate, VIX down to ~16.0 (from 16.70), DXY softening to 100.78, oil declining. The Korea shock (SK Hynix -10.96%) that drove NVDA's July 2 decline has substantially reversed (SK Hynix +10.88% on July 3 KST, KOSPI +5.76%). This means the primary non-US negative catalyst from July 2 has been largely absorbed.

**China H200 catalyst:** The most significant development in the holiday gap is the reported reopening of China's access to NVIDIA H200 chips. If confirmed, this represents a material demand expansion — China AI companies have been rationed from H200-grade compute for 18+ months. The demand backlog could be significant. The holiday trading reference of $194.44 vs. July 2's $193.70 close (+$0.74) may already embed a partial H200 rumor premium.

**Pattern context — false breakout resolution:** NVDA's July 1 breakout above $200 (close $200.09) reversed within 2 sessions. This is the classic 'false breakout above round number' pattern. Historical resolution: (1) retest of the origin of the breakout ($192–$195 zone), (2) stabilization and re-attempt of the breakout. NVDA has tested the $192–$193 zone and stabilized (July 2 close $193.70, intraday low $193.45). The pattern is consistent with stabilization before re-attempt — NOT with a breakdown below the correction low ($192.53).

**★ Strongest support — $192–$193 zone:** Unchanged from prior analysis. June 26 correction low ($192.53), July 2 intraday low ($193.45), and heavy put-OI wall at $190 strike create a multi-layer support band. Three tests without a closing breach ($192.53, $193.45, $193.70) confirm structural demand at this zone.

**★ Strongest resistance — $200:** Two session failures after the July 1 close ($200.09 barely cleared). The $200 round number continues to anchor options OI and define the full-size add gate. A July 6 recovery to $195–$197 would represent progress but not a Gate 3 clear. Volume above 200M on a close above $200 on July 6 would be the cleanest re-entry signal.

**Stop Day 2 probability assessment:** Given improving macro (VIX -4%, SPX futures +0.7%), China H200 headline, SPCX inclusion tailwind, and SK Hynix recovery confirming the Apple/CXMT narrative was a 1-day panic, Stop Day 2 probability on July 6 has materially declined from the moment of Stop Day 1 trigger. The framework does not assign probabilities — but the circumstantial case for NVDA closing above $195 on July 6 is stronger than at 4PM ET on July 2.
